official_vector_policy.noble_keygen: lowest-tcId case from every parameter-set group
official_vector_policy.noble_sigver: lowest-tcId positive and lowest-tcId negative case from the first external/pure group for every parameter set
official_vector_policy.noble_siggen: lowest-tcId case from the first deterministic external/pure group for each representative signing set
official_vector_policy.circl_native_acvp: run upstream ACVP suite against the FAE-pinned corpus; upstream-defined long-test skips are evidence and are not reclassified as passes

PQ-04.selection_rationale: Frozen before execution to cover NIST security categories 1/3/5, SHA2/SHAKE families, and small/fast parameter profiles without turning PQ-04 into the resource-economics study reserved for PQ-09.
PQ-04.gate: official-vector surface plus representative cross-implementation signing demonstrates diversity viability with no unexplained disagreement

execution_rules: failed runs remain evidence and cannot be erased by selective retry
a harness defect may invalidate a run only with an explicit preserved reason
wrappers over the same core do not create new independence
active FAE runtime, wallet, Transaction v2, address and consensus files remain outside write authority

execution_binding.note: Wave D is executed by the established PQ workflow already present on main; the standalone bootstrap workflow was removed as redundant.
